title: 第四章 是时候表演真正的技术了
content_zh:
方甫踏入内堂，就感觉三道锐利的目光投向自己。
穿绯袍的应该是府尹，绣云雁，嗯，是四品大员......胸口绣银锣的这位大叔，嘶，打更人组织的.....我去，这姑娘好颜值，太漂亮了吧.....嫁人了吗？
再扫了眼胸脯，许七安冷静了许多。
迅速低头，表现出很谦卑的姿态。
陈府尹高坐大椅，面无表情，审问犯人的腔调颇具威严：
“许七安，三日前下狱的时候，你可没说自己有重要线索。你可知隐瞒不报的后果。”
官场老油条，哪怕心里急的要死，开口绝不问线索，而是心理施压。
能来到这里，说明计划已经成功了一半，许七安还算冷静：“大人，就在方才，许家二郎来找我了，我问他要了卷宗。”
首先要诚实。
在场三人都知道许新年，并不是他有多出名，而是身为许平志的长子，三位主办自然会有调查。
“这和你说的线索，有何关联？”陈府尹问道。
“草民便是从卷宗里推理出了案件的真相....”
“等等，”陈府尹打断他，身子微微前倾：“从卷宗里？”
这和他想的不一样。
“我已经破案了。”许七安点点头，表示就是如此。
陈府尹压住喊人把这小子送回大牢的念头，脸色严肃：“你说说看，不过本官提醒你，信口雌黄的话，两百个板子可以打的你骨肉分离。”
“税银被劫案，其实不是妖物所为，而是人为。”
一句话，惊了三个人。
陈府尹猛一拍桌，怒喝道：“胡说八道，来人，拖下去，杖责两百。”
妖物劫走税银，几乎是盖棺定论的事情，是三位主办的共识。

如果之前期待许七安能给出有价值的线索，现在则是彻底失望。
无非是毛头小子狗急跳墙的狂悖之言。
中年男人眼睛微微一亮，挥退了冲进来的衙役，“陈大人稍安勿躁。”
他目光一转，盯着许七安，灼灼的，带着审视和期待：“你说说看。”
这位陈府尹脾气有些暴躁....许七安知道该自己表现的时候了，“根据城门守卫的口供，我二叔是在卯时二刻进的城，辰时一刻，押送税银的队伍抵达广南街，这时，怪风忽起，马匹受惊冲入河中。”
他尽量让语气便的不卑不亢，显得自己更镇定，从而增加说服力。
陈府尹点点头：“这便是我们断定此乃妖物潜藏与河中，伺机抢走税银的理由。”
“不！”许七安大声反驳：“妖风只是障眼法，河中爆炸也是障眼法，其实是为了让你们忽略一个破绽，一个致命的破绽。”
陈府尹急迫追问：“什么破绽。”
中年男人摆出了倾听姿态。
黄裙少女咬着蜜饯没嚼，那双灵气四溢的眸子，饶有兴趣的盯着许七安。
卷宗他们翻来覆去看了许多遍，对案发经过了如指掌，却不曾察觉出有什么破绽。
“我二叔押送税银十五万两，敢问几位大人，十五万两白银，重几斤？”
中年男人一脸僵硬，黄裙少女则歪了歪脑袋，半天没正回来。
陈府尹不悦道：“有话就说，别卖关子。”
许七安原本是想给出提示，让几位大人自己勘破这个巨大的破绽，但似乎弄巧成拙了。
速算能力有点low啊，你们这群古代人.....许七安当即道：“是九千三百七十五斤。”
按照这个世界的质量换算公式，一斤十六两，十五万两白银是九千三百七十五斤。
中年男人皱了皱眉，他隐约间把握到了什么。
黄裙少女蹙眉：“这能说明什么？”

她嗓音如银铃般清脆。
说明你不太聪明的亚子！
许七安道：“从城门口到广南街，路程多少？”
中年男人回道：“三十里。”
“途中经过几个闹市？”
“.....四个。”
“驽马脚程如何？”
“驽马.....”中年男人忽然双眼圆瞪，猛的站起身。
他用力瞪大双眼，露出了一种‘竟然是这样’、‘原来是这样’的恍然表情。
三天的追踪、搜捕妖物踪迹一无所获，这位经验丰富的打更人已经意识到可能走错方向。
但头脑里没有一个清晰的思路，所以之前被否定后，便没放在心上。
陈府尹头皮有点麻，因为他仍旧没有听出有什么问题，显得他这个府尹特别没有智慧。
陈府尹看了眼黄裙少女，心里平衡了不少。
黄裙少女郁闷道：“哪里有问题？”
中年男人有些振奋：“时间，时间上不对。”
“广南街距离南城门足有三十里，以驽马的脚力，沿途要经过四个闹市，卯时二刻进城，不可能在辰时一刻抵达广南街。”
他这是受了先入为主的影响，认为这是妖物作祟劫走税银，经过许七安的抽丝剥茧，立刻咀嚼出了问题。
“可是税银确实是在辰时运送到广南街，当时目睹匹马冲入河中的百姓有不少，不可能是假的。”黄裙少女脆生生道。
陈府尹满意的点头，附和：“这是何解？”
这....中年男人愣住了，下意识的看向许七安。

“因为押送的根本不是银子。”许七安掷地有声。
“荒谬！”陈府尹反驳道：“且不说你二叔和押运的士卒有没有眼睛，卷宗中有录入当时在场百姓的供述，马匹冲入河水，白花花的银子滚入水中。”
他抖了抖手里的卷宗：“这也有假？”
“眼见不一定为实.....草民愿意亲自为大人解惑，”他目光落在桌案上：“借纸笔一用。”
陈府尹挥了挥手，示意自便。
许七安拖着镣铐来到桌边，倒水研磨，铺开宣纸，歪歪捏捏的写了起来。
“大人，请按照草民的要求，准备纸上之物。”写完，他把宣纸递给陈府尹。
陈府尹接过宣纸扫了一眼，一头雾水。
“我看看。”黄裙少女过来凑热闹，伸出雪白柔荑接过宣纸。
然后一头雾水。
“......”中年男人李玉春扫了一眼纸张，做出面无表情的样子，不漏痕迹的把宣纸折起的一角压平，然后递给陈府尹。
content_en:
When Fang Fu stepped into the inner hall, he felt three sharp eyes directed at him.
The one wearing the scarlet robe should be Fu Yin, Xiu Yunyan, um, a fourth-rank official... The uncle with the silver gong embroidered on his chest, hey, he is from the watchman organization... Let me go, this girl is so good-looking, too pretty... Is she married?
Glancing at his chest again, Xu Qian calmed down a lot.
He bowed his head quickly, showing a very humble attitude.
Chen Fuyin sat high on a big chair, his face expressionless, and his tone of interrogating the prisoner was quite dignified:
"Xu Qian, when you were imprisoned three days ago, you didn't say you had important clues. Do you know the consequences of concealing it and not reporting it?"
A veteran official, even if he is extremely anxious, he will never ask for clues when he opens his mouth, but will put psychological pressure on him.
Being able to come here means that the plan has been half successful. Xu Qi'an is still calm: "Sir, just now, Erlang of the Xu family came to see me, and I asked him for the file."
Be honest first.
The three people present knew Xu New Year, not because he was famous, but as Xu Pingzhi's eldest son, the three organizers would naturally investigate.
"How does this relate to the clue you mentioned?" Chen Fuyin asked.
"The common people deduced the truth of the case from the files..."
"Wait a minute," Chen Fuyin interrupted, leaning forward slightly: "From the file?"
This was different from what he thought.
"I have solved the case." Xu Qian nodded, indicating that that was it.
Chen Fuyin suppressed the idea of calling someone to send this kid back to prison, and said with a serious face: "You can tell me, but I remind you that if you talk nonsense, two hundred paddles can separate your flesh and blood."
"The robbery of tax money was actually not the work of monsters, but man-made."
One sentence shocked three people.
Chen Fuyin slammed the table and shouted angrily: "That's nonsense. Come on, drag me down and give you two hundred sticks."
It is almost certain that the monster stole the tax money, which is the consensus of the three organizers.
If he had expected Xu Qi'an to give valuable clues before, he was completely disappointed now.
It's nothing more than the arrogant words of a young boy who jumps over the wall in a hurry.
The middle-aged man's eyes brightened slightly, and he waved away the government servant who rushed in, "Mr. Chen, please be patient."
He turned his gaze and stared at Xu Qian, sternly, with scrutiny and expectation: "Tell me about it."
This Chen Fuyin had a bad temper...Xu Qian knew it was time for him to show off, "According to the confession of the city gate guard, my second uncle entered the city at 2:00 pm. At 1:00 pm, the team escorting the tax bank arrived at Guangnan Street. At this time, a strange wind suddenly rose, and the horses were frightened and rushed into the river."
He tried his best to keep his tone neither humble nor overbearing, making himself appear calmer, thus increasing his persuasiveness.
Chen Fuyin nodded: "This is the reason why we concluded that this is a monster hiding in the river, waiting for an opportunity to steal tax money."
"No!" Xu Qian retorted loudly: "The demonic wind is just a cover-up, and the explosion in the river is also a cover-up. In fact, it is to make you ignore a flaw, a fatal flaw."
Chen Fuyin asked urgently: "What's the flaw?"
The middle-aged man took a listening posture.
The girl in the yellow dress bit into the candied fruit, staring at Xu Qi'an with interest with her aura-filled eyes.
They read the file over and over many times, and they knew everything about the case, but they never noticed any flaws.
"My second uncle is escorting 150,000 taels of tax silver. May I ask some of the adults, how much does 150,000 taels of silver weigh?"
The middle-aged man had a stiff look on his face, while the girl in the yellow skirt tilted her head and didn't come back for a long time.
Chen Fuyin said displeasedly: "If you have something to say, just say it and don't hold back."
Xu Qi'an originally wanted to give a hint and let several adults investigate this huge flaw on their own, but it seemed to be self-defeating.
Your quick calculation ability is a bit low, you ancient people...Xu Qi'an immediately said: "It's nine thousand three hundred and seventy five kilograms."
According to the mass conversion formula in this world, one pound and ten poundsSix taels, 150,000 taels of silver is nine thousand three hundred and seventy five kilograms.
The middle-aged man frowned, and he vaguely grasped something.
The girl in the yellow skirt frowned: "What does this mean?"
Her voice is as clear as a silver bell.
It shows that you are not very smart, Yazi!
Xu Qian asked: "How long is the distance from the city gate to Guangnan Street?"
The middle-aged man replied: "Thirty miles."
"How many busy cities did you pass on the way?"
"....Four."
"How's the journey going?"
"Horse horse..." The middle-aged man's eyes suddenly widened and he stood up suddenly.
He opened his eyes hard, showing a look of surprise that said, "It turns out to be like this," and "It turns out that it is like this."
After three days of tracking and searching for the monster, the experienced watchman realized that he might be going in the wrong direction.
But I didn’t have a clear idea in my mind, so after being denied before, I didn’t take it to heart.
Chen Fuyin's scalp felt a little numb because he still didn't hear anything wrong, which made him seem to be a particularly unintelligent Fuyin.
Chen Fuyin glanced at the girl in the yellow dress and felt a lot more balanced.
The girl in the yellow dress said depressedly: "What's the problem?"
The middle-aged man was a little excited: "The time, the time is wrong."
"Guangnan Street is thirty miles away from the South City Gate. With the strength of the horse's feet, it has to pass through four busy cities along the way. It is impossible to reach Guangnan Street at a quarter past midnight when entering the city."
He was influenced by his preconceptions and thought it was a monster that was causing trouble to steal the tax money. After Xu Qian peeled off the cocoon, he immediately discovered the problem.
"But the tax money was indeed transported to Guangnan Street at Chenshi. At that time, many people saw the horse rushing into the river. It can't be a fake." The girl in the yellow dress said crisply.
Chen Fuyin nodded with satisfaction and echoed: "What's the explanation for this?"
This... the middle-aged man was stunned and looked at Xu Qian subconsciously.
"Because what is being escorted is not money at all." Xu Qian said loudly.
"Absurd!" Chen Fuyin retorted: "Not to mention whether your second uncle and the escorting soldiers have eyes. The files contain the confessions of the people who were present at the time. The horses rushed into the river and the white silver rolled into the water."
He shook the file in his hand: "Is this also false?"
"Seeing is not necessarily believing... Common people are willing to help you solve your doubts in person." His eyes fell on the desk: "Borrow me a pen and paper."
Chen Fuyin waved his hand to indicate that he could help himself.
Xu Qian dragged his shackles to the table, poured water to grind it, spread out the rice paper, and started writing crookedly.
"Sir, please prepare the things on paper according to the requirements of the common people." After writing, he handed the rice paper to Chen Fuyin.
Chen Fuyin took the rice paper and glanced at it, confused.
"Let me take a look." The girl in the yellow skirt came over to join in the fun, stretched out her white catkins and took the rice paper.
Then confused.
"..." The middle-aged man Li Yuchun glanced at the paper, made an expressionless expression, flattened the folded corner of the rice paper without leaving any trace, and then handed it to Chen Fuyin.
